candidates.proposed_objective_text: Determine whether closed number sentences are true or false.
candidates.evidence_quote: Decide whether closed sentences are true or false
candidates.rationale: The textbook first teaches and assesses closed number sentences so learners can contrast them with open sentences. That is measurable prerequisite content, but the canonical AO does not ask learners to determine truth values of closed sentences.

candidates.proposed_objective_text: Evaluate algebraic expressions for given variable values.
candidates.evidence_quote: Find the value of the following expressions if $x=3$.
candidates.rationale: The textbook includes a full expression-evaluation lesson segment. Substituting a given value into an expression is measurable, but it is not the same as solving an open sentence for missing information.
